## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.14.2

### 📷 Cameras
- Sends Home Assistant trickle ICE candidates to the X-Sense signal server as soon as the relay offer is sent, instead of holding them until an SDP answer arrives.
- Covers the live-view case where the browser offer contains no embedded ICE candidates and sends them separately.

### 🪵 Debug Logging
- Reduces repeated camera ICE queue debug lines while keeping candidate summaries in the logs.
